hero.title: Industrial supply, from request to delivery
hero.description: We cover component procurement, customization and planning so your team can focus on production.

procurement.title: Component procurement
procurement.description: We source the components you need from leading brands.
procurement.longDescription: We find the right components for your application, even when they are not available from regular distributors. We check stock, propose compatible alternatives and negotiate favorable terms.
benefits: Alternatives for unavailable or obsolete parts

customization.title: Customization
customization.description: We adapt components and solutions to your technical requirements.
customization.longDescription: We configure, assemble and adapt components for your specific application. From cable assemblies and kits to complete solutions, we deliver exactly what your project needs.

planning.title: Planning and inventory
planning.description: We plan procurement and deliveries for a continuous production flow.
planning.longDescription: We analyze your bill of materials (BOM) and plan long-term procurement with scheduled deliveries and inventory management, so production never stops.

process.title: A simple, predictable process
process.description: Four steps, from your request to components delivered to production.

steps.title: Your request
steps.description: You send us your component list or project specifications.

steps.title: Analysis and quote
steps.description: We check availability, find alternatives and prepare the quote.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.description: We confirm lead times, prices and delivery terms.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: We deliver on time, with all the related documentation.
